geometry_analysis.width_description: Uniform width, consistent along the length.

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Distinct clusters of deep black voids located at BOTH the Start (Left) and End (Right) of the weld bead. The porosity is not limited to a single pore but appears as a group at both termination points.
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: High; systemic failure at process switching points

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Large, irregular, rust-brown islands of glassy material adhered along the bead centerline. They are larger and more irregular than the 'dashed' inclusions seen in Sample 24.
Steep contact angle at the toes, consistent with the batch characteristics.

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Fine granular spatter on base metal
surface_state.discoloration: Metallic grey with significant rust-colored patches
